page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Margin notes in small type in the right margin, partly illegible. Gathering signature at the foot, centred under the text. Left-edge marks are show-through from the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: bant: eo autem usque obsistere se, simulabant, donec ad ἀνδρεῖον[?] raptorum esset perventum: quod si raptor indignus videretur, re vera puerum ei auferebant. Amorem mereri putabant, non qui pulchritudine forma, sed qui fortitudine & morum modestia praestabat. Raptor puerum donis ornatum abducebat quocunque volebat; comitabantur vero, qui raptui intervenerant: convivati deinde atque una venati per bimestre (diutius enim detinere puerum non licebat) in urbem redibant.

Tum puer dimittebatur muneribus multiplicibus egregiè honoratus. à dimisso autem sacrum magnificum fiebat, & epulum lautum & copiosum dabatur, in quo, quàm gratam expertus esset cum raptore consuetudinem, verbis palàm profitebatur: licebatque ei, si quid violentius post raptum passus esset, ab amatore discedere, & poenas quoque ab illo poscere.

Turpe vero habebatur puero pulchro, & nobili genere nato, amatorem sui non invenire: moribus quippe ejus id imputabatur. Raptus autem [illegible, ~3 letters] honori erat. Nam & in cursu, & in c[illegible, ~8 letters] sessu loca iis honoratissima tribuebant & veste fulgebant illustri ab amatore donata, eoque decore gaudebant non solum[?] pueri, sed etiam cum jam adole-sent, atque inde agnoscebantur κλ[?] [illegible, ~4 letters]

page.notes: The right margin carries several very small, faded marginal marks and possibly notes; only fragments are legible, and they are given as illegible. The Greek word ἀνδρεῖον is read with doubt. Line ends with "κλ", which is not clearly part of the text and may be a mark or Greek catchword; it is kept with [?]. The gathering signature reads "c 5" but is partly smudged. The word after "in c" is hidden by margin marks, so it is marked illegible. "solum" is partly obscured. Show-through and left-edge marks from the adjacent page are excluded.
